caption:
Unpopular opinion: 😤

Being "good with money" is easier when the bills are smaller.

You can skip lattes all year and one car repair still wipes you out.

Anyone else tired of being told it's a discipline problem?
first_comment: What was your last surprise bill? No judgment. 👇
